categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Kylinsec Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: operating systems, information security, and cloud computing. The company develops and sells high-security, high-reliability domestic operating systems, including server, desktop, and embedded versions. It also provides data security storage products and network and endpoint security solutions. Additionally, it offers cloud computing products such as cloud desktops, lightweight cloud platforms, and integrated hyper-converged appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include a Linux-based domestic operating system with enhanced security, real-time virtualization, and multi-architecture CPU support (including domestic CPUs like Kunpeng, Feiteng, Loongson). It integrates commercial cryptography algorithms and trusted computing frameworks. Cloud computing products leverage proprietary remote desktop transmission protocols, distributed storage, and heterogeneous virtualization technologies. Information security products utilize transparent NAS and SAN encryption, high-speed cryptographic acceleration engines, and secure data exchange technologies. Production is order-driven, combining software development with hardware assembly and integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from critical infrastructure sectors such as national defense, electric power (including State Grid and Southern Grid), government, finance, telecommunications, transportation, education, and healthcare. The company serves large state-owned enterprises, government agencies, and military units requiring high-security and domestically controlled IT solutions. It also targets emerging markets driven by digital transformation and cloud adoption.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant revenue generated from regions including North China, East China, Central China, South China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast China. Its headquarters and main R&D center are located in Changsha High-tech Zone, Hunan Province. The company has established regional marketing and technical service networks across these key Chinese regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hunan Kylinsec operates primarily in the midstream segment of the IT supply chain, focusing on software development (operating systems, security software, cloud platforms) and integration with hardware components. It procures hardware components such as servers, storage devices, and thin clients from suppliers and assembles integrated solutions. The company also provides technical services and solutions to end customers, positioning itself as a platform software provider and system integrator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing domestic operating system technology, cloud computing, and information security products aligned with national digital sovereignty goals. It emphasizes R&D investment in kernel security, real-time virtualization, cryptographic frameworks, cloud desktop protocols, and distributed storage security. The company actively participates in open-source communities (e.g., openEuler), industry standard setting, and ecosystem building. Future R&D priorities include AI integration, industrial control systems, heterogeneous computing, and enhanced cloud-native capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through one-time software product sales with licensing fees, combined hardware-software integrated product sales, and ongoing technical service contracts. The company also offers subscription-based models for cloud platform products via major cloud marketplaces (Huawei Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Tianyi Cloud). Additional income streams include government subsidies, investment income from financial assets, and sales of technical development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic providers of secure, trusted operating systems and cloud solutions in China, with a strong foothold in critical sectors like defense and electric power. It competes with other domestic OS vendors and international players in server OS, cloud computing, and security markets. Its early adoption and deployment in national key industries, combined with integration of commercial cryptography and multi-CPU architecture support, provide competitive advantages. However, it faces competition from established global software vendors and emerging domestic players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 163 million, a 59% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to slowed procurement and project delivery in the defense sector. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 30 million, reflecting increased R&D and marketing investments. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.43 billion, with net assets around RMB 1.27 billion. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains a strong R&D focus, with R&D expenses accounting for nearly 50% of revenue, indicating a growth-oriented investment profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hunan Kylinsec emphasizes its products’ high security, reliability, and domestic control, critical for national security and key infrastructure sectors. Its operating systems support multiple domestic CPU architectures and integrate commercial cryptography algorithms certified by national authorities, ensuring compliance and trustworthiness. The company offers a full-stack solution combining OS, cloud computing, and information security products tailored for critical industries. Its deep industry customization, strong R&D capabilities, and ecosystem participation differentiate it from competitors, enabling secure, efficient, and scalable IT infrastructure solutions.
